TentaryAPIKeyCredential.title: Tentary API Key
TentaryAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Tentary, open AI & API and create a personal API key. Paste the key alone, without Bearer. Read operations need read permission; writes need a key with write permission.

code.description: The code buyers type, like SUMMER20. Unique in the shop (upper and lower case count as the same).
code.title: Code

percent.description: Discount in percent. Give percent or amount.
percent.title: Percent

amount.description: Fixed discount. Amount in the account currency, like 49 or 19.99.
amount.title: Amount

max_uses.description: How often the code can be used in total. 0 = no limit. On create, left out = no limit. On update, left out = no change, null removes the limit.
max_uses.title: Max Uses

starts_on.description: First day the code works, like 2026-11-27. On create, left out = at once. On update, left out = no change, null removes the date.
starts_on.title: Starts On

ends_on.description: The code stops at the start of this day (00:00). On create, left out = no end. On update, left out = no change, null removes the date.
ends_on.title: Ends On

product_ids.description: Only these products (ids from list_products). null = all products. On create, left out = all products. On update, left out = no change. [] = no product (the code works nowhere).
product_ids.title: Product Ids

description_html.description: Introduction as HTML. Shows only with layout cards, above the modules.
description_html.title: Description Html

cover_image_url.description: Course banner: the image_url from finish_image, or a public image URL that Tentary copies.
cover_image_url.title: Cover Image Url

layout.description: How buyers see the course. classic (default): sidebar and content. fullscreen: edge to edge. fokus: reading without distraction. cards: a start screen with module cards.
layout.title: Layout

tracks_progress.description: Buyers can mark lessons as done (default true). Needed for release type after_lesson.
tracks_progress.title: Tracks Progress

type.description: The product type (see above). update_product cannot change it.
type.title: Type

price.description: Amount in the account currency, like 49 or 19.99. 0 = free. Paid prices start at 1.00. For external: the price shown on the card.
price.title: Price

description_html.description: Sales page text as HTML (p, h1-h4, strong, em, ul, ol, li, a, img, blockquote; a with class "button" is a button). The page always has its own buy button. A buy button in the text links to the url of the product + "/checkout" (create_product and get_product give url); there is no #buy anchor.
description_html.title: Description Html

checkout_description_html.description: Extra text only on the checkout page, HTML. Not for external.
checkout_description_html.title: Checkout Description Html

link_url.description: link: the link that buyers get.
link_url.title: Link Url

access_text_html.description: link: text that buyers see after purchase. bundle: extra details for the buyers. HTML. Takes the placeholders of text blocks.
access_text_html.title: Access Text Html

course_id.description: course: the course that buyers get (from list_courses or create_course). Needed to go live.
course_id.title: Course Id

marketing_emails.description: Subscribe buyers to the marketing e-mails (always on for newsletter).
marketing_emails.title: Marketing Emails

pdf_stamp.description: Stamp PDFs with the buyer's e-mail address.
pdf_stamp.title: Pdf Stamp

login_protection.description: Buyers must log in to open the product.
login_protection.title: Login Protection

show_in_search.description: Show the sales page in Google.
show_in_search.title: Show In Search

hide_in_shop.description: Do not show the product on the shop page.
hide_in_shop.title: Hide In Shop

coupon_field.description: Show the coupon field at checkout (default true).
coupon_field.title: Coupon Field

stock_limit.description: How many can be sold. null or 0 = no limit.
stock_limit.title: Stock Limit

buy_button_text.description: Text of the buy button. Empty = default.
buy_button_text.title: Buy Button Text

url_slug.description: Own URL part: shop URL/p/<url_slug>. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
url_slug.title: Url Slug

access_days.description: Access ends this many days after purchase (3 to 9999). null or 0 = no end.
access_days.title: Access Days

access_starts_on.description: Buyers get access from this day at the earliest (for example the start of a program). Before it they wait. null = at once. Not for newsletter and external.
access_starts_on.title: Access Starts On

customer_id.description: The id from search_customers or from an order.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

order_id.description: The id from list_orders (not the order number).
order_id.title: Order Id

from_date.description: First day (UTC) for new and ended subscriptions, like 2026-01-01.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: Last day (UTC), like 2026-12-31. Default today. 731 days at most.
to_date.title: To Date

variant_id.description: Needed for a product with variants (get_product shows them).
variant_id.title: Variant Id

reason.description: Shown in the app. Default manual.
reason.title: Reason

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

status.description: paid = paid and not refunded. refunded = paid with a full or partial refund (the rows show status paid). pending = payment in progress or an open bank transfer.
status.title: Status

product_id.description: Only orders of this product (id from list_products).
product_id.title: Product Id

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer (id from search_customers).
customer_id.title: Customer Id

from_date.description: Only orders created on or after this day (UTC), like 2026-01-31.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: Only orders created on or before this day (UTC), like 2026-01-31.
to_date.title: To Date

search.description: Part of the buyer's e-mail address, or the order number.
search.title: Search

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

variant_id.description: Only the grant of this variant. Leave out for all variants of the product.
variant_id.title: Variant Id

query.description: Part of the name or e-mail address. Leave out for all customers.
query.title: Query

paid_only.description: Only customers with at least one payment that was not refunded in full (order, subscription or installment payment, paid payment reminder).
paid_only.title: Paid Only

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filters and limit again: the cursor does not keep them. Leave out for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

status.description: archived = switched off. active = on again.
status.title: Status
